node.statement: Under the square lower bound now stated explicitly as a local hypothesis of node 1.2, nodes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 give, for every nonzero Z, ||h_n(Z)||^2 >= a_n||Z^dagger dot Z||-C_prod e||Z||^2 >= ((1-K_sq e)a_n-C_prod e)||Z||^2; here a_n>=0 because it is an infimum of nonnegative norm ratios. After division, write r_Z=||h_n(Z)||/||Z||>=0. Then r_Z^2>=B for all nonzero Z, where B=(1-K_sq e)a_n-C_prod e. Since inf_Z r_Z^2=(inf_Z r_Z)^2=a_n^2, the conditional recurrence follows. This uses the square bound only as the explicit premise and does not infer it from a threshold or from the two upstream lemmas; consequently no conclusion uniform in n is obtained unless that missing premise is independently supplied.
